title: Camelid agent-loop eval case (SCAFFOLD — not executed by any script)

description.description: Must name the exact real capability or bug this case targets, e.g. referencing commit a6b660cf.

modelRowId.description: Must resolve to a real row id in fixtures/ledger-excerpt.json (or a future fuller ledger fixture) with tool_capable: true. Never a made-up model name.

workspaceRoot.description: Real, reachable path the live agent's workspace session is rooted at. Never fabricated.

task.description: The natural-language instruction sent to the agent, e.g. 'list the files here and read one of them.'

toolCallsExpected.description: Only read-only tools — write/shell/network/subagent tools are not supported per the real web_workspace contract and must never appear here.

contentShouldBeEmptyWhenToolCallsPresent.description: Per commit a6b660cf: when tools fire, content is expected to be emptied and tool_calls populated. A grader must check this exact shape, not just 'did something happen'.

mustNotClaim.description: Capabilities the real web_workspace contract explicitly disclaims. A case must never expect these to succeed.
